title: c4-map index (docs/architecture/map.json)
description: What `c4-map gen` (~/claudecode/bin/c4-map; spec claudecode docs/specs/c4-base-map.md, FR-12) writes to an initiative's docs/architecture/map.json: one index of the base map, its three levels (L1 context, curated; L2 containers and L3 modules, generated) with every drawn node, its grounding and its edges. Writer: c4-map (Hephaistos, factory). Readers: bin/diagram-check (the ungrounded flag: a drawn node whose grounding is empty) and the Deltagos map lens (organizer docs/ux/specs/map-and-roadmap.md: the map rendered once from the level SVGs, node ids kept as element ids, a lens is classes on those ids; a container opens into its modules; a node's grounding paths shown). The sample is expected.json for the synthetic fixture claudecode tests/c4-map/fixture/ (an invented ferry-ticket shop). Deterministic: the same inputs give the same bytes; no wall-clock time. Versioned by `schema`; a reader refuses another major.

system.description: The id of the system (c4.json `system`): the L1 node of kind system whose containers L2 draws, and the id of the L2 boundary subgraph.

inputs.description: Each repo of initiative.yaml `repos:` that exists: its HEAD sha (40 hex), or null when the directory is not a git repo of its own. The map was made from these.

levels.description: One entry per level diagram found: context (L1), containers (L2), and one modules entry (L3) per container that has one. Ordered context, containers, modules by container.

page.description: The page holding the diagram, relative to docs/architecture/ (c4.json `pages`; default context.md, containers.md, modules.md).

svg.description: The rendered SVG `mermaid2svg <page> --check` writes for that diagram: <page>-<n>.svg, n the diagram's position among the page's mermaid blocks, relative to docs/architecture/. Each node is an element with id `flowchart-<id>-<k>` (mmdc 11.12 on lodestar; another mermaid build may prefix it with `<svg-id>-`), each subgraph an element with id `<id>`.

container.description: modules only: the container id the diagram opens.

nodes.description: Every node a level diagram draws, sorted by level (context, containers, modules) then id. An id is unique within its level; an external may appear at L1 and at L2 under the same id. A grounding row with no drawn node is not here (c4-map check flags it `undrawn`).

id.description: The stable id (snake_case; c4-map check flags any other as `bad id`). Never renamed by a regeneration (c4.json `ids` lock).

label.description: The text drawn, HTML tags replaced by spaces.

kind.description: From the node's grounding row; null when it has none.

parent.description: The subgraph that holds the node in its diagram: at L2 the system id for containers and stores, null for externals; at L3 the container id; at L1 null unless drawn in a subgraph.

status.description: exists; ruled (ruled to be built, grounded by its record); retiring. null when the node has no grounding row.

grounding.description: The evidence that the node is real, empty when ungrounded (no row, or a blank evidence cell): diagram-check flags `ungrounded: <id>` for a drawn node whose grounding is empty at any level.

edges.description: Every edge a level diagram draws, deduplicated, sorted by level then from, to.

evidence.description: From the level's `| from | to | evidence |` table; empty when it has no row.

ref.description: repo: <dir>@<short sha> (a container) or <dir>/<path> (a module); deploy: <dir>/<file>[ key <KEY>] or an adapter's own reference; record: the record number; curated: the page. Never a value.
